# Bespoke Quizzes and Games

> London quiz host Tom Bridge writes and hosts bespoke quiz nights and game shows for office Christmas parties, team socials, corporate events and private parties. Every quiz is written for one group only, with rounds about the people in the room. Prices from £350.

- Based in London, travels further for the right booking
- 20 to 100+ guests; offices, pubs, bars, restaurants and private venues
- Includes: bespoke quiz writing, live hosting, mic, PA, slides, printed answer sheets (no apps)
- Signature rounds: picture round featuring the guests, bespoke Price is Right, Higher or Lower, music round, themed general knowledge, balloon bursting finale
- Clients include LEGO, Canva, Haleon, Titanbay, Club Quarters, Slack and Enfuse Group
- Rated 5.0 by clients
- Contact: tom@bespokequizzesandgames.com
